subject: Map Kickoff: Novacare - Draft MAP and timeline options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@novacare.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: MAP Kickoff: Novacare - Draft MAP and timeline options

Hi Jordan / Maya —

Great to chat today — thanks for the time and for walking us through Novacare's inference needs and launch constraints. As promised, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft with proposed milestones, owners, and a couple timeline options so you can pick what aligns with your procurement and integration windows.

Quick summary of next steps I captured from the call:
- Confirm stakeholders for procurement, security review, and engineering integration (listed in the first tab of the MAP).
- Choose target timeline: Option A (4 weeks to pilot, 8 weeks to production) or Option B (6 weeks to pilot, 12 weeks to production) — see "Timeline options" section.
- Security questionnaire kickoff: Novacare security to loop in any control owners; we’ll send SOC2 artifacts and a per-scope checklist once we have stakeholder contacts.
- Contract/PO: If finance wants an SOW or pricing sheet early, I attached our SOW template to speed that path.

Attachment: redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP draft - milestones & owners)
Attachment: SOW-template.pdf

Can you confirm who from Novacare should be on the MAP as the primary owner for procurement and the technical integration lead? Also which timeline option do you prefer, or do you want us to propose a hybrid?

I’ll loop Aditya in for a technical kickoff once we have the integration lead email.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
redwoodinference.com

---
This email contains attachments: redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW-template.pdf (PDF).

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@novacare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <m.patel@novacare.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Novacare - Draft MAP and timeline options

Thanks Marissa — really appreciate the clear write-up and the MAP draft. Quick answers from our side: 

- Procurement owner: Maya Patel (cc’d) — she will own PO and contract routing.
- Technical integration lead: Jordan Ellis (me) for initial integration; I’ll later hand off to our platform team once pilot is underway.
- Security reviewer: I’ll introduce our InfoSec lead (Derek Shaw) in a follow-up — we’d prefer to run the security questionnaire in parallel with the pilot if possible.

Timeline — I’m leaning toward Option A (faster pilot) because we want to validate latency/cost before committing. That said, procurement at Novacare may need up to 3 weeks to route a PO depending on vendor onboarding.

Can you confirm what the critical dependencies are for hitting Option A so we can align internally? Also, can Aditya attend a short technical kickoff on Mon 16 Feb at 10am PT?

Jordan
Director of Platform Engineering | Novacare Inc.
j.ellis@novacare.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

On Thu, Feb 12, 2026 at 4:05 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Great to chat today — thanks for the time and for walking us through Novacare's inference needs and launch constraints...

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@novacare.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Novacare - Draft MAP and timeline options

Jordan — thanks for the quick reply and preference for Option A. I can join the technical kickoff Mon 16 Feb at 10am PT.

A few critical dependencies to hit the 4-week pilot (Option A):
- Access: We need a short-lived test dataset (anonymized) and a service endpoint or example traffic profile to validate latency and token cost.
- Model choice: Decide whether you want a latency-optimized smaller model for pilot vs. a higher-capacity variant; I can run perf/cost estimates after we see traffic.
- Security: If InfoSec requires in-depth evidence, getting the SOC2 package and a primary security contact early will avoid hold-ups.
- Network: If you're planning a private deployment behind a VPC, we’ll need network firewall rules and a short window to test connectivity during pilot.

I’ll prepare an agenda for the kickoff and share a short checklist to make the pilot runnable within the proposed timeline.

—Aditya
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

Perfect — thanks Jordan and Maya. 

Summary / agreed actions:
- Novacare: Maya (procurement owner) to kick off vendor onboarding and share PO timeline (action: Maya).
- Novacare: Jordan to share anonymized test dataset or example traffic and add Derek Shaw (InfoSec) to this thread for the questionnaire (action: Jordan).
- Redwood: Aditya to send pilot checklist + agenda and join Mon 16 Feb 10am PT kickoff (action: Aditya).
- Redwood: Marissa to share updated MAP with owners and a recommended Option A timeline that factors in a 2–3 week PO route (action: Marissa).

I’ll upload the updated MAP to the shared Drive link and attach the SOW template for your legal team to review. 

If this looks right I’ll update the MAP and we can lock the kickoff on Mon 16 at 10am PT.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
